summary: Updated implementation plan incorporating exact support for the warehouse's FLEXI-MATTE (4FT 1.3M, 5FT 1.85M, 10FT 3.2M) and SAV-GLOSSY/MATTE (3FT, 4FT, 5FT) rolls, name-based roll width parsing (fixing 50m x 50m SAV entries), duplicate roll handling, and one-click printer roll confirmation.
